newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures cut losses, hit highs on auction.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures cut losses, hit highs on auction.

text.p: Nov 7 - U.S. debt futures erased most losses, rose to fresh session highs immediately after results of the 30-year T-bond auction. The sale produced an average yield of 6.619 pct, on low end of forecasts for 6.64 to 6.62 percent. The high yield was 6.625 pct, bid/cover at 2.68, non-comp bids totalled $258 million. Dec T-bonds neared resistance at 113-24/32. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
